summary: Positive half: a bare '# Codex Session Scrollback' H1 yields title='Codex Session Scrollback' with no REQ-011.2.1 violation, so a doc-ID-prefix requirement would fail the test. Negative half: three distinct kinds of content preceding the H1 — prose, no H1 at all (file starts at '## Overview'), and an opening code fence — each raise REQ-011.2.1 from the real parseSpec.
